description: GET /health returns 200 with status ok once the app has started
steps: Assert status is 200 and body status equals ok

description: GET /health first succeeds within 1000 ms of process start
steps: Assert first 200 arrives at or under 1000 ms after start

description: Log lines are single-line JSON containing timestamp, level, correlation_id and message
steps: Capture log output while calling GET /health
Assert the four keys are present on every line

description: Supplied X-Correlation-ID is propagated to logs and response header, and generated when absent
steps: Assert response header equals abc-123 and log lines carry abc-123
Call without header and assert a UUID4 is generated and echoed

description: Case-scoped requests log case_id
steps: Call a case-scoped endpoint with a known case_id
Assert at least one log line contains the same case_id

description: Log redaction filter removes PAN, Aadhaar, contact, income and occupation values from output
steps: Log a message and extra fields containing synthetic PAN ABCDE1234F, Aadhaar 123412341234, phone, email, income and occupation
Assert none of the plaintext values appear and a redaction marker is present

description: Missing DATABASE_URL aborts startup with an error naming the variable
steps: Start the app or instantiate Settings
Assert a startup error is raised and its message contains DATABASE_URL

description: Migration guard fails when an existing migration is modified or removed

Modify an existing migration in a temp copy and assert guard fails
Delete one and assert guard fails

description: Migration guard passes when a new migration file is appended
steps: Add a new migration and update manifest with the new entry only

description: Login with valid seeded credentials returns a bearer token and role
steps: Assert access_token non-empty, token_type is bearer and role is kyc-analyst

description: Login with wrong password returns generic 401
steps: POST login with valid username and wrong password
Assert error body does not state whether username or password was wrong

description: Seed data contains one synthetic user per role
steps: Apply migrations to a fresh test DB
Assert four users exist with the four distinct roles

description: Stored passwords are hashed and never logged
steps: Read password column of seeded users
Assert value is not equal to the plaintext password and has a hash prefix
Perform login and assert captured logs do not contain the plaintext

description: Missing token returns 401 and wrong role returns 403 on a protected endpoint
steps: Call GET /api/v1/review-queue with no token and assert 401
Call it with prospect token and assert 403
Call it with compliance-officer token and assert 200

description: Authorization is enforced only in controller layer
steps: Statically scan service and repository packages for imports of the auth dependency module

description: Expired token is rejected with 401
steps: Wait 2 seconds and call a protected endpoint

description: Prospect cannot read another prospect's case
steps: Create two cases with two prospect tokens
GET case B using token A

description: Staff role can read any case
steps: GET case A using kyc-analyst token

description: Valid lead returns 201 with case_id and state INITIATED
steps: POST /api/v1/leads with name, phone and product Savings
Assert case_id is a UUID and state equals INITIATED

description: Each of the three products is accepted
steps: POST leads for Savings, Current and NRE
Assert each returns 201 and echoes the product

description: Invalid lead payloads return 422 and create nothing
steps: POST leads omitting name, then with contact 12345, then with product Loan
Assert each returns 422 with errors naming the offending field
Assert case count in DB is unchanged

description: Lead creation writes audit entry and initial history row
steps: Query audit log and state history for the case_id
Assert LEAD_CREATED and INITIATED rows exist with UTC timestamps

description: Case read returns state, product and checklist

Assert state INITIATED, product Current and checklist includes BUSINESS_PROOF

description: Case read masks contact
steps: Assert contact equals ********12 and raw number does not appear in body

description: Profile can be saved while INITIATED

Assert 200, the owning prospect's GET returns the stored profile, and the staff GET returns profile null with profile_complete true (DD-5)

description: Profile is locked after submission and rejects non-integer income
steps: PUT profile with annual_income 3000000.5 and assert 422

description: Repeated lead POST with same Idempotency-Key does not create a second case
steps: Assert second response carries the same case_id

description: Each permitted edge succeeds

Assert new state equals the to-state

description: Every non-permitted state pair is rejected
steps: Enumerate all 7x7 state pairs minus the 8 permitted edges

description: Invalid transition raises the typed exception with context

description: API maps the exception to 409 INVALID_STATE

Assert body error code is INVALID_STATE

Inject failure after state update and assert neither persisted

description: Terminal states permit no outgoing transition

Execute raw UPDATE and DELETE on each
Assert the database raises an error
Assert repository classes define no update or delete method

description: Duplicate transition request is idempotent

Assert one history row and unchanged state

description: Checklist endpoint returns items and version
steps: Assert body has version and items array

description: Only kyc-analyst can reject documents

description: Re-upload creates a new version and retains the old one

Assert chip becomes Verified and case_id and state text are unchanged

Assert zero float literals, float() calls and float annotations

Assert bands LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH
